sources.title: Energizer Alkaline Application Manual, Fig. 12 and the fresh open-circuit example
sources.ref: Three E91 cells in series. Fig. 12 is an AA cell at 0.1 A down to 0.8 V: 1.2 V at 15 h and 0.8 V at 25 h, so the charge left at 15 h is 0.4 of the 25 h test. The manual's fresh open-circuit example is 1.6 V. Pack knots are three times those cell voltages: 2.4 V at soc 0, 3.6 V at soc 0.4, 4.8 V at soc 1. Fig. 12 is a loaded curve; the internal drop at 0.1 A is not added back, and that correction is assumed small. vCutoff is 2.4 V, three times the 0.8 V end of Fig. 12. Capacity is 9000 C, the Fig. 12 0.1 A times 25 h, and a series pack has one cell's charge.

sources.title: Energizer E91 datasheet, nominal internal resistance
sources.ref: Fresh cylindrical alkaline internal resistance is 0.15 ohm to 0.3 ohm. The pack uses 0.45 ohm, the low end of that range times three cells. Fig. 9's dual-pulse example is 0.214 ohm for one cell; the low end of the fresh range is the choice here.

sources.title: Three cells, not four
sources.ref: Four fresh cells are about 6.4 V. A Nano 5V pin absolute maximum is 6 V, so four cells are above what that pin may take. This pack is three cells, about 4.8 V fresh.
